name: Fontana Mayor's Youth Advisory Council (MYAC)
what_you_do: Plan city teen events and service projects, help run the yearly Teen Leadership Summit, and learn how city government works. You can earn 40 or more service hours.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students ages 12 to 18.
duration: One term, from the first Monday of July to the last Monday of June. Members go to quarterly Commission and Council meetings.
deadline_text: The page says member applications for 2026 to 2027 open in May, so that round has passed. Expect the next round around May 2027. Members-at-Large can apply now for a lighter role.
how_to_apply: Fill out pages 3 to 5 of the MYAC form, with the short essays. Add at least one recommendation letter from a professional reference. Send it by email to MYAC@fontanaca.gov, by mail, or bring it in.
notes: Members get a MYAC polo after 30 service hours. Board members interview in May. Members-at-Large help at events when they can. Office: Community Services, 17001 Upland Ave. Hotline: (909) 349-6960.
